answers.core: It looks not possible or very hard to get access to Windows Registry from add-on via reading binary files and parse it.
answers.workaround:
I think, that my case (check and read Registry keys) is not the only one. `RegistryKey` class is needed if you want to recreate old game engine, that uses Registry to save some values or configs.
So looks like this class will be used often enough.

title: Add class to work with Windows Registry
